purpose: Use the scale of the public NAAMP archive to test whether the focal within-taxon concentration excess persists under genuinely blocked spatial and temporal prediction, rather than only random route cross-fitting.
frozen_primary_endpoint: Exactly the existing within-taxon concentration endpoint: sum choose(max(k-1,0),2) over acoustically route-new taxa, conditionally residualized on simulated route-new-taxon and total extra-stop rainfall coefficients.

comparator.species_response: Species-specific wet-shift gamma estimated from stop-positive counts using log1p(DaysSinceRain), mean temperature, annual sine/cosine, State and RunNumber nuisance terms; minimum information remains 20 positive stop cells and 5 positive routes.
comparator.site_history: Same strictly-prior species x physical-SiteID probability model and dry-state persistence anchor as the current principal comparator.
comparator.magnitude_conditioning: Observed wet incidence magnitude is matched exactly as in the existing principal comparator; this is conditional allocation transferability, not prediction of total activation magnitude.

spatial_block.training_rule: For every focal pair, species wet-shift gamma is trained on eligible runs from all other States and never on any run from the focal State.
spatial_block.history_rule: The focal State's strictly-prior physical-SiteID history may be used because it is information available before the focal pair; focal-pair and future history are excluded by the existing prior-history rule.
spatial_block.primary_test: Pool all focal pairs after assigning each its no-self-State species gamma; compare the observed conditional concentration residual with 1,000 simulations.

temporal_block.test_period: Pairs with year_earlier >= 2009; both members are therefore in 2009-2015.
temporal_block.species_training: Species wet-shift gamma uses only eligible runs with SurveyYear <= 2008.
temporal_block.history_training: Physical-site history is frozen to eligible prior runs with SurveyYear <= 2008; no 2009-2015 history is used to build the template.
temporal_block.primary_test: Evaluate the same conditional concentration residual only in the temporally held-out pairs, with 1,000 simulations.

classification.excess_transfers: observed conditional residual exceeds the simulated upper 95% bound
classification.directional_only: residual is positive but does not exceed the upper 95% bound

interpretation_boundaries: This is post-hoc transferability assessment, not independent confirmation.
The spatial test transfers the species rainfall-response component across States while retaining strictly-prior local site history.
The temporal test is stronger: both species response and local site-history template are frozen before 2009.
Observed wet incidence magnitude remains conditioned on, so the test concerns spatial allocation conditional on response magnitude.
No causal rainfall, literal synchrony, individual movement, occupancy change or unique mechanism is inferred.
No cutoff, structural gate, endpoint, tail or classification may change after blocked outcomes are read.
